title: AreaPaths
description:
The paths of the cells around a point of a worldspace, or of an
interior cell.

cells.description: Outside, the cells read, as column and row; inside, empty.

makers.description:
The plugins that made a version of a navigation mesh here, in load
order. Triangles name their maker by its place in this list.

navmeshes.description: The navigation meshes, in the version the game uses.

overHidden.description:
Where the objects asked about would leave paths over nothing: the
paths the game uses that run over them.

place.description: The worldspace or interior cell asked about.

AreaNavmesh.description:
One navigation mesh in the version the game uses, with who made each
of its triangles.

cell.description:
Where it lies, for people: an interior cell's internal name, or the
worldspace and the cell's grid position.

doors.description:
Where characters step through a door: the middle of each door
triangle, in whole game units.

gone.description:
How many triangles of the game's own last version this one no
longer has in the same place.

links.description:
Where the paths lead on into a neighbouring mesh: the middle of each
linked edge, in whole game units.

madeBy.description:
For each triangle, who made it as it is, by its place in
[`AreaPaths::makers`]: the first plugin from which on every version
has it unchanged.

navmesh.description: The mesh, by the plugin that first defined it, as `plugin:number`.

takenOut.description:
The triangles the version the game uses takes out of the paths:
still there, but leading nowhere, as a repair leaves them.

triangles.description: Its triangles: three corner numbers each.

versions.description:
The plugins with a version of it, in load order, by their place in
[`AreaPaths::makers`]; the last is the one the game uses.

vertices.description: The corners of its triangles: three whole game units each.

MakerKind.description: Who made a version of a navigation mesh.

oneOf.description: The game itself: one of its own plugins.
Mod Mallet's plugin of repaired paths (ADR 0058).

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.

PathsMaker.description: A plugin that made a version of a navigation mesh in the area.

plugin.description: The plugin, in the spelling of the load order.

PathsOverHidden.description: The paths the game uses over one object asked about.

object.description: The object, as it was asked about.

triangles.description:
The triangles over it, by their numbers in that mesh. Triangles
already taken out are left out.
